[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.13 (Sādhanapāda) — Sati mūle tadvipāko jātyāyurbhogāḥ | Pages 419-427]

 kuśalasya na–apakarṣāya–alam /
Kasmāt ? kuśalam hi me bahv anyad asti yatra–ayam āvāpaṃ gataḥ svarge'py apakarṣam
alpaṃ kariṣyati iti / Niyata-vipāka-pradhāna-karmaṇā–abhibhūtasya vā ciram avasthānam /
Katham iti ? Adṛṣṭa-janma-vedanīyasya
1072 niyata-vipākasya–eva karmaṇaḥ samānaṃ
maraṇam abhivyakti-kāraṇam uktam, na tv adṛṣṭa-janma-vedanīyasya–aniyata-vipākasya
1073 /
Yat tv adṛṣṭa-janma-vedanīyaṃ karma-aniyata-vipākaṃ tan naśyed āvāpaṃ vā gacched
abhibhūtaṃ vā ciram apy upāsīta, yāvat samānaṃ karma-abhivyañjakaṃ nimittam asya na
vipāka-abhimukhaṃ karoti–iti / Tad vipākasya–eva deśa-kāla-nimitta-anavadhāraṇād iyaṃ
karma-gatir vicitrā
1074 durvijñānā
